name: AgentRouter
short: Chinese-language multi-model gateway reselling Claude Opus 4.6-4.8, GPT-5.5 and GLM 5.2 through one API key at ~27% of official list price; pay-as-you-go only - no public free tier (enterprise trial quotas by sales request).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Claude Opus 4.8 $8/$40; Opus 4.7 $8/$40; Opus 4.6 $2/$10; GPT-5.5 $4/$8; GLM 5.2 $3/$4.5 (input/output). Balance never expires; no minimum spend. Claims ~27% of official list price.

plans.name: Enterprise seats
plans.notes: Monthly seat quotas without weekly limits, SSO/RBAC, usage audit; contact sales. Enterprise trial-quota pilots offered via sales (homepage "大额快速试用").
